text:
alexa: Customer acme-prodsvc reporting embeddings throughput regression since ~03:10 UTC — tokens/sec steady but vectors/sec down ~4x. No obvious 5xxs but tail latency up. They mentioned occasional dim mismatch errors. Any quick thoughts? :worried:

devin: Can you paste a sample request payload? Mixed dims in a batch force fallback to slow path (CPU or per-item GPU runs) which can crater vecs/sec.

alexa: Snippet from the customer request (redacted):
```
{"client_id":"acme","model":"redwood-embed-002","inputs":[{"id":"a1","text":"...","dim":769},{"id":"a2","text":"...","dim":768}]}
```

sre_jen: That explains it — mixed-dim batches. Runtime fast-path expects homogeneous dims for a single kernel. If batch contains varying dims we fall back to per-item processing and break batching efficiency. Can you check queue depth/gpu util around the time? Run: `kubectl -n infer get pods -l app=embed-svc -o wide` and hit `http://metrics.internal/embeddings/queue_depth?env=prod`.

maria_ml: Also note we had an autoscaler/batching rollout earlier at 03:10UTC — saw `batch_window_ms` change in the deploy: 12 -> 40ms. Longer coalescing increases chance of assembling mixed-dim batches from concurrent clients.

alexa: Metrics: queue_depth spiked to 180 at 03:12, GPU util ~98%, and we see kvcache/backpressure logs. Example log excerpt:
```
[03:12:05] WARN kvcache: drop_prefix_cache: eviction=1 wait_ms=22
[03:12:07] INFO batch: created_batch_size=64 dims=varied fallback=cpu_path
```

devin: Yep — mixed dims + large batches = kernel selection failure -> CPU conversions and GPU stall for other queues. Short-term: set `batch_dim_validation: strict` (reject mixed-dim batches) and reduce `max_batch_size` for that model from 64 -> 32 to avoid long-lasting stalls. That will return errors to clients but prevents whole-host throughput collapse.

support-bot: Incident INC-5421 created, priority P1, assigned to eng-ml and eng-sre. :rotating_light:

tom_r: Checked auth/billing — token auth OK (200) and no billing throttle spikes. This is infra/perf, not rate-limiting.

alexa: Deployed canary config to 3 hosts: `batch_dim_validation: strict` + `max_batch_size: 32`. Monitoring now.

maria_ml: We should add a metric for mixed-dim rate and alert if >0.5% of batches. I'll open a PR to add `embedding.router.mixed_dim_rate` and an alert rule. Also add a small router unit-test to avoid coalescing mixed-dim groups.

sre_jen: Agreed. Also add a debug trace for batch kernel selection so we can see fallback counts in prod dashboards.

devin: Repro script for QA (quick):
```
for i in {1..500}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-002","inputs":[{"text":"x","dim":768},{"text":"y","dim":769}]}' &

done
```
This reproduces the ~4x vec/sec drop in our perf harness.

alexa: After canary change vecs/sec on canary hosts recovered from ~1200 -> ~4200 (back to baseline). Rolling the change to remaining hosts in 10m. :thumbsup:

maria_ml: Follow-ups: add router alert, unit test, and a KB note for customers advising consistent input dims per request. I'll file PR and KB draft.

tom_r: I'll notify Acme with mitigation steps + ETA.

alexa: Prod rollout finished, no regressions in next 30m. Will close INC-5421 once PR + KB are merged. Thanks all. :tada:
